verdict.rationale: Working Copy ships a conversational Repository Agent that performs Git and file actions directly. Nothing in the evidence shows it turning plain-language requests into shell commands, so the agent is an adjacent feature, not this capability. Natural-language command generation is a fair axis for an AI-enabled developer tool, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can describe what I want in plain language and have the tool generate the corresponding shell command
